tools.name: send
tools.description: Sends a peer the caller may send requests a request; its ID, which the peer's answer carries.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Answers a request a peer sent the caller, by its ID.

tools.name: hand
tools.description: Hands a peer a file of the caller's scratch, /tmp: a request where the caller may send the peer requests, or, with id, the answer to its request of that ID. The file is a regular one, which the caller's group may read, of at most 1 MiB less its name; its server opens it beneath /tmp, through no link, and reads it whole.
